events_event_has_range_check.name: events_event_has_range_check
events_event_has_range_check.value: "events"."kind" <> 'event' or ("events"."starts_at" is not null and "events"."ends_at" is not null)

events_recurring_has_base_check.name: events_recurring_has_base_check
events_recurring_has_base_check.value: "events"."rrule" is null or "events"."starts_at" is not null or "events"."ends_at" is not null

events_all_day_remind_check.name: events_all_day_remind_check
events_all_day_remind_check.value: not "events"."all_day" or (coalesce("events"."remind_start_minutes", 0) in (0, 1440) and coalesce("events"."remind_end_minutes", 0) in (0, 1440))
